name: TC-172: removing an applied gift card clears the discount
description: After applying a gift card, clicking Remove clears the 'Gift card applied' summary and returns to the code-entry state.
descriptionHtml: After applying a gift card, clicking Remove clears the 'Gift card applied' summary and returns to the code-entry state.

testStage.description: After applying a gift card, clicking Remove clears the 'Gift card applied' summary and returns to the code-entry state.

steps.name: Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Fill "AUTOGCMUTJNM3LU0SOXX" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText(/Gift card applied: -\$\d/)
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove', exact: true })
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText(/Gift card applied: -\$\d/)
